title: NIT Kurukshetra Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 04 Junior Engineer Posts
description: National Institute of Technology Kurukshetra (NIT Kurukshetra) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 04 Junior Engineer Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.E./B. Tech, Diploma in Civil Engineering, or Electrical Engineering can take this opportunity and apply for the NIT Kurukshetra Notification 2026 .
